what: For each horizontal line of the menu button, the current line slides out to the right (line width + 4px, .8s), and .1s later the same line hidden off to the left slides in and settles in place — the lower line follows 80ms later so the two lines flow staggered. On release it returns to the initial shape instantly with no curve

options.[data-fx-part=row]: One row (child) — contains two of the same line element (the first leaves and the second comes in). If there is only one line, it only leaves
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) — STUDIO default transition curve
options.--fx-gap: Distance the line extends beyond the row (via style), default 4px
options.--fx-lag: Delay until the back line follows in (set via style), default 100ms
options.--fx-stagger: Extra delay per row (via style), default 80ms — the third row is double
options.--fx-out: Return duration on release (via style), default 0s (instant, like the original)

from.where: shared.js .hm-burger — original STUDIO button :hover lines translate 56px (line 52px) · back line −56px→0, 800ms · delay 0/100ms (top line) · 80/180ms (bottom line), default transition 0ms
